title: Best of Both Worlds | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Best of Both Worlds is a 4.00 bedroom, 3.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Looking for a vacation rental that offers the "Best of Both Worlds"? Nestled in the sought-after south of 30A in Seagrove Beach, this home is where Eastern Lake meets the sea, creating an idyllic setting for your stay. Boasting 4 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, it comfortably accommodates up to 14 guests, making it a fantastic choice for families or group getaways. With a private heated pool and a golf cart provided for effortless trips to the beach, this home sets the stage for a truly enjoyable vacation. Situated on a secluded street, it offers ample parking for multiple vehicles, even a small RV or trailer, along with a spacious front yard perfect for relaxing or outdoor activities.Start your day on one of the home’s inviting decks, sipping coffee as you soak in the crisp morning air and lush treetop views. Alternatively, unwind in the screened porch overlooking the pool for a more serene start. Inside, the open and airy layout welcomes you with large windows, cozy sofas, and a TV for entertainment. The dining area, thoughtfully designed to bring everyone together, comfortably seats six and creates the perfect ambiance for shared meals, laughter, and conversations. The fully equipped kitchen complements this experience with modern appliances, a coffee maker, toaster, refrigerator with an ice maker, and a kitchen island with seating for four—ideal for casual breakfasts or evening chats.On the first floor, you’ll find a comfortable Queen bedroom with its own TV and a private bathroom complete with a dual vanity. A washer and dryer add extra convenience during your stay. Upstairs on the second floor, restful nights await in the master bedroom with a TV, a private bathroom featuring a garden tub, and dual vanities. Additional guest bedrooms include a king bed and a full bed, each equipped with a TV, and a hallway bunk nook with twin beds that share a bathroom with a tub.For the kids, the third floor offers two custom bunk bed sets, one trundle bed, and an attached bathroom, providing a fun and functional space they'll love. This level also features a spacious deck, perfect for enjoying the fresh air and creating lasting memories. It’s sure to be a favorite retreat for younger guests!Step outside to enjoy your private pool, which can be heated upon request, and fire up the BBQ grill for a delightful family cookout. The beach is just 0.6 miles away, offering easy access to the sugar-white sands and emerald waters.Explore nearby attractions such as Greenway Station on 30A, Café 30A, Seagrove Market, Surfing Deer, Perfect Pig, The Big Chill, Old Florida Fishhouse, Seaside, and WaterColor for shopping and dining.Beach Access:Head south on Gulf Drive to Eastern Lake Beach Access or west on Eastern Lake Road to Ramsgate Beach Access.Distance: 0.6 miles | Time: 12 minutes walking or 3 minutes drivingSeagrove Beach:Nestled on 30A’s oak-lined coastline, enjoy adventure and relaxation. Bike the Timpoochee Trail, explore Seaside, Grayton, Alys, and Rosemary Beach, with boutique shops, dining, and parks to discover.Your stay at Best of Both Worlds comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Additional Information:*Dog Friendly: A non-refundable pet fee will be added if bringing a pet. Contact us if you're bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs, each up to 30 lbs, is allowed. See our rental policies for more details.*Pool Heated: Year around upon request with daily heating fee.A starter set of amenities is provided: The kitchen includes paper towels, a sponge, dish soap, dishwasher pods, kitchen wipes, trash liners, and laundry pods. Each bathroom has toilet paper, facial and bath soaps, body wash, shampoo, and conditioner. Towels include one body towel & washcloth per guest, plus two hand towels per bathroom.
